name: io.github.chatmaid/mcp
title: Chatmaid WhatsApp
description: Send WhatsApp messages to contacts and groups, read replies, and check delivery via Chatmaid.

environmentVariables.name: CHATMAID_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Chatmaid API key: sk_test_* for the sandbox (nothing is sent), sk_live_* for real messages

environmentVariables.name: CHATMAID_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (defaults to https://developers-api.chatmaid.net)
